headline: EverWind To Build Nova Scotia Data Center, Lease to AI Developer
headline_vi: EverWind để xây dựng trung tâm dữ liệu Nova Scotia, thuê cho nhà phát triển AI
summary: EverWind Fuels Co. has announced more than C$10 billion ($7.1 billion) for a data center campus and wind generation infrastructure in Nova Scotia, calling it the largest privately funded investment in the province’s history.
